scope: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY adapter source reuse, candidate-only formulas, synthetic edge cases, and sealed real feature-only parity; not service-scale model quality

reproduce.default_without_optional_flags: Synthetic checks and independently vectorized synthetic RH230 parity only
reproduce.writes: No output files; unittest and JSON evidence are printed

real_feature_parity.selection: First three original contexts per cap; positive actual history for nonzero caps; first ten available target indices per context
real_feature_parity.score_columns_read: row_id and x000 through x229 only
real_feature_parity.comparison: All float32 feature values exactly equal sealed foundation340 RH/score.parquet

source_review.gbt_sealed_checks: 41/41 fit-file, execution and native inventory checks passed

factor_inventory.canonicalization: UTF-8 compact sorted JSON of combination340-relative file path to bytes/sha256

source_review.remaining_source_anchors: SOURCE_SHA256 and REFERENCE_CODE_SHA256 in the hash-bound adapter; verified by load_assets/reference_classes

verified_behavior: Service IDs are metadata identities, never model features or MovieLens factor IDs
Only unambiguous MATCHED service rows inherit MovieLens train count and factors
Requested cap determines calibration; mapped/supported history length does not replace it
Cap zero ALS calibration remains unavailable; GBT handles the complete candidate set
Original, shrink20, shrink100 and min20 use separate declared formulas
Only required candidate heads are computed, including warm-only and empty skips
Ranking preserves affine unclipped values; rating_clipped is separate for error/display
Viewed/history movies and invalid/duplicate indices are rejected
Metadata additions and row reordering preserve existing feature and prediction values
limits: Current 237817-service-film raw normalization and service-axis feature parity require the separate prepare-input audit
No real trained-model service prediction, timing benchmark, quality evaluation or model selection was executed by this review
Previously used development users and current metadata do not establish fresh-test, historical-only, Korean-user or discovery-satisfaction performance
Caller must cap original latest-first inputs before mapping and enforce past-time and candidate-eligibility gates
